answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing escrowed tasks whose results are checked by randomly selected, stake-bearing reviewers. A reviewer who approves a fabricated result loses part of its stake when later audits expose the fraud, while the worker forfeits its own bond. Creating more identities therefore does not create free votes: each must lock scarce capital, and coordinated cheating risks losing it. A comet-themed task, a marble shipment, or a garden plan follows the same rule.
